description: The carry register (Jess Haley, 2026-10-26, V_eta_go_forward_class_audit.md [carry register], with the kind `needs_mapping` from [one correct reading]): every reason the generic migration carries a v1 document whole as v1 is one row here, so that a carry is never read as "V2 is missing a field". A row names the v1 class, its field(s), when the carry happens, its kind and the decision (document and tag). Kinds: `awaiting_home` (V2 should model it; `open_work` names the OPEN_WORK row, null when none is filed yet, and `home` says what the home is), `needs_mapping` (the v1 document admits several readings; `homes`, `decides`, `resolved_by` name the V2 homes, what decides between them and the dataset map entry that resolves it), `not_modelled` (V2 models it elsewhere or not at all, by design; `do_not` is the line a class must not contradict: `class` must not declare any of `fields`), `malformed` (input no writer produces). Checked by tools/check_carry_register.py. Every carry note a migrator writes is to cite its row (Build pending: DID-matlab, NDI-matlab). `kind_basis`: `stated` when the decision line gives the kind; `decided` when Claude read it from the line and the team confirmed it ([carry register kinds]); `proposed` when Claude read it and the team has not confirmed it (Proposed, not decided).

rows.when: a medium or air treatment (Babu: the substance the worms live on), whose reading as exposure or dose the v1 document does not decide
homes: exposure (a manipulation: the medium the subjects live on)
rows.decides: whether the substance is the medium the subjects live on or a dose given to them; the v1 document does not say
rows.resolved_by: the Babu dataset map entry, e.g. "Babu: MICRO:0000480 -> exposure" ([one correct reading])

rows.when: a heat-only treatment (Babu), whose reading as a temperature manipulation or a dose the v1 document does not decide
rows.decides: whether the treatment is heat alone; the v1 document does not say
rows.resolved_by: the Babu dataset map entry for its heat treatments (not yet written)

rows.when: its term is not a ChEBI substance and does not state its number's kind, so its kind, direction or unit would be chosen from label words (DID-matlab treatment.m)
rows.decides: what the treatment means in its dataset; the v1 document states only a label and a number
rows.resolved_by: the dataset map entry for that treatment term (not yet written)

rows.when: a ChEBI substance with no recorded location (DID-matlab jTreatmentBodies.m, route 'unknown')
homes: manipulation (immersion: the subject sat in it)
rows.decides: where the treatment was given; the v1 document does not say

rows.when: a ChEBI substance whose recorded location is not an UBERON body site (DID-matlab jTreatmentBodies.m, route 'needs_mapping'); carry-020 is the Babu case

rows.when: its label marks it as a mask or a label map, which only label words show (DID-matlab image_stack.m)
